card_tooltips.english: Revenge: Apply Frostbite 1 to the attacker. Strike: Apply Frostbite 1 to the attacked enemy. Resolve: Gain Armor 5, then apply Frostbite to all enemies on this floor equal to current Armor divided by 5 (rounded down).

character_tooltips.english: Revenge: Frostbite 1 to attacker. Strike: Frostbite 1 to defender. Resolve: Gain Armor 5, then apply Frostbite equal to floor(current Armor / 5) to all enemies on this floor.
